Model questions

WES2000A FAQ

What is the rated capacity of the WES2000A?

The stated rated capacity is 2,000 kg. Final suitability depends on load center, lift height, attachment, and operating conditions.

What is the lift specification of the WES2000A?

The listed lift specification is 1,600-3,500 mm. Confirm the required maximum height and residual capacity before ordering.

What information is needed to quote the WES2000A?

Provide load weight and dimensions, lift height, aisle or route conditions, daily duty, battery requirement, quantity, and destination.
